verdict.rationale: Godot documents its own headless mode: the `headless` display server runs on machines without a GPU or display, and a runtime probe confirms `godot --headless` is used for CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation. That lets game code execute against the real engine in CI. However, the evidence never shows a built-in unit or integration test runner, test discovery, assertions, or CI test reporting; it only shows headless execution and command-line workflows. missing for 10: a documented first-party test framework or runner, integration-test harness guidance, CI exit-code and report conventions, and independent hands-on corroboration of tests running in CI.

support.subject: As a game developer, tests run headlessly — unit and integration tests of game code execute in CI against the real engine
